summary_en: 1,600,000 shares (0.79% S/O), ¥2,841.6M, ToSTNeT-3, settlement 2026-08-12. Execution price 1,776 yen/share (day's close). Part of broader 3.5M-share (1.72% S/O) authorization approved same day, execution window 2026-08-12 through 2027-02-26.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares by off-floor purchase (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Blue Zones Holdings' board resolved on 2026-08-10 to acquire up to 1.6 million treasury shares (0.79% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥2.84 billion via off-floor ToSTNeT-3 purchase on 2026-08-12 at the day's closing price of ¥1,776/share. Execution is scheduled for 08:45 JST on 2026-08-12; the order is limited to that specific time window with no option to extend to other trading systems or hours. Results will be announced after trading closes that morning. This block purchase forms part of a broader shareholder authorization approved the same day: a 3.5 million share program (1.72% S/O) for ¥5.88 billion maximum, executable between 2026-08-12 and 2027-02-26 using both ToSTNeT-3 and open-market methods. The 1.6 million share block may be only partially or fully foregone depending on market conditions.
